Scrapes, crawls, maps and searches the web, returning clean markdown or structured data.

## API key

1. Open [firecrawl.dev](https://www.firecrawl.dev/app/api-keys) and create an API key with only the access your apps need.
2. Copy it. It may be shown only once.

**What to create:** An API key from Firecrawl's API keys page.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add firecrawl
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  firecrawl: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls Firecrawl's [API](https://docs.firecrawl.dev/api-reference/introduction) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. Use `"write"` if the app changes things. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show firecrawl` shows the key as set.

**Cost:** Credits: 1 per page scraped or crawled, 1 per map call, 2 per 10 search results; JSON extraction and other options add more.

**Rate limits:** Per team per minute, by plan: /scrape 10 on Free, 100 Hobby, 500 Standard, 5,000 Growth; /crawl 2, 20, 100, 1,000.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Firecrawl).
